milestone.title: raul path: tree view — drop board, migrate awaiting-approval, branch-per-blocked

intent.outcome: `raul path` renders a vertical `git log --graph`-style tree: one execution trunk (ready/approved/dep-met milestones in topo order) with four labeled side-branches — awaiting-approval, blocked, grooming, review. Blocked milestones fork at their dependency milestone and merge when the dep completes. The board tab/flag and its 7-column render are removed; board's 'awaiting approval' lane migrates into path. Backlog leaves the path view. One surface replaces two overlapping ones.

problem.description: board (TUI-only, 7 columns) and path (CLI + TUI, 5 swimlanes) overlap conceptually — both bucket milestones by workflow state, just along different axes (review-state vs execution-DAG). Two surfaces to maintain, two classification code paths (raul's `classify_card` on spec+exec+findings vs mp's `path_engine::build_lanes` on lifecycle+exec+deps), and the human reader must mentally reconcile them. Board's horizontal columns don't convey dependency/blockage structure, which is what 'what do I do next' actually needs; its 'awaiting approval' lane has no path equivalent. The current path swimlanes are flat — they don't show that a blocked milestone forks off a specific dependency, nor that review loops back to the trunk. Result: the two views answer the same question ('where are my milestones') differently and incompletely, and neither shows the topology. Consolidating onto a single tree-shaped path closes the gap.

in_scope: `raul path` CLI: new vertical tree renderer (execution trunk + awaiting-approval/blocked/grooming/review branches + collapsed done baseline). Replaces the swimlane graph as the default; `--table` fallback retained for narrow terminals
TUI Path tab: rewritten as a scrollable vertical tree (replaces the current 5-column path tab)
New 'awaiting-approval' branch migrated from board: spec_status=ready AND lifecycle not yet approved. Joins the execution trunk on `mp milestone approve`
Blocked branch forks at the dependency milestone: milestones sharing a blocker share one fork point; the fork merges when the blocker completes
`mp path_engine.rs::build_lanes`: add an `awaiting-approval` lane so raul consumes it via `mp path --all` (preserves the 'mp classifies, raul renders' contract)
Remove `raul --board` flag + Board TUI tab + `classify_card` + the board render module + the board data path (`list_milestones_with_findings` + `reviews_lifecycle` for board purposes)
Collapse done/complete milestones into a one-line baseline footer (not a branch)
Backlog removed from `raul path` (stays in `raul backlog` / Backlog tab — 144 items would drown a milestone tree)
out_of_scope: No new top-level raul verb; everything stays under `raul path` + the Path tab
No change to `mp path` JSON wire shape beyond adding the one new lane
No backlog surface changes (`raul backlog` and the Backlog tab are untouched)
No raul keybind / theme overhaul (orthogonal, separate milestones)
Board's review-state columns (Open Findings / Remediated / Verified) are NOT migrated as distinct branches — they collapse into the review branch (with finding markers) and the done baseline

Blocked milestones fork at their dependency milestone and share a fork point when blocked-by the same milestone.

findings.description: Dead binding in crates/raul/src/tui/path_view.rs::render: last_idx = exec_items.len() - 1 is computed then discarded every loop iteration via let _ = last_idx. Remove.

TUI bypasses the single-sourced M-prefix label rule. CLI uses path::format_item_label (M125 ER-3 single source); TUI hand-rolls format!("M{} - {}", id, title) in trunk_item_line/flat_branch_lines/blocked_lines. The TUI test fixture tui_path_tree.rs uses id:M99 which does NOT match the real mp path wire shape (raw 99/110, no M prefix) and would render MM99; the loose contains(M99) assertion masks it. Route both renderers through format_item_label and fix the fixture ids to raw.

blocked-fork grouping (path_tree.rs::render_blocked_forks and path_view.rs::blocked_lines) inserts into a BTreeMap but iterates via a separately-tracked order:Vec, so the BTreeMap sort is dead/misleading. Use a HashMap or the shared grouping helper. Folds into the F-01 consolidation.

Duplicated tree logic: BRANCH_ORDER, lane_map, display_name, first_dep, deps_str, join_detail, branch_detail and the blocked-fork grouping are copy-pasted between crates/raul/src/path_tree.rs (CLI) and crates/raul/src/tui/path_view.rs (TUI). AC-05 requires the TUI to mirror the CLI; duplication is how they silently diverge (see F-02/F-03). Consolidate the data-shaping into a shared module; keep only the output-medium code (ANSI vs ratatui Span) per emitter.

AC-07 force-bypass (accepted reviewer observation, NOT an M157 defect): cargo test -p mp has one red - mp_coordinator_walks_planning_then_reviewing (install --skills=mp-coordinator produces templates/harness/cursor/skills/master-planner/README.md below the 1-byte min). Verified pre-existing: fails identically on ff808a1^ (M157 parent). Root cause is the stale master-planner skill template (M141), documented in M145 evidence - NOT M157. Reviewer accepts the bypass for M157; recommend a track item to restore the template so AC-07 goes honestly green. No code change under M157.
